name: magi
description: Magi — the pentester's familiar. Engagement checklists, targets and evidence (web app + CLI)

scripts.app: sh -c 'for e in electron electron43 electron42 electron41 electron40 electron39; do command -v $e >/dev/null && exec $e .; done; echo "no electron runtime found" >&2; exit 1'
scripts.pkg:all: npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb AppImage --mac zip
scripts.test: node scripts/migrate-smoke.mjs && node scripts/stash-smoke.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/server-smoke.mjs && node scripts/link-smoke.mjs && node scripts/link-migrate-smoke.mjs && node scripts/sync-smoke.mjs && node scripts/sync-skew-smoke.mjs && node scripts/backup-smoke.mjs && node scripts/mfa-smoke.mjs && node scripts/io-smoke.mjs && node scripts/qr-smoke.mjs && node scripts/crypto-smoke.mjs && node scripts/jwt-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:backup: node scripts/backup-smoke.mjs && node scripts/mfa-smoke.mjs && node scripts/io-smoke.mjs && node scripts/qr-smoke.mjs
